45–90 min (mostly the walk through the jungle)

A pirate forgot his treasure in a cave behind a waterfall, near the lair of the treacherous {creature:Hydra|Hydras}, in Tiquanda. Cross the jungle to the hidden hole near {npc:The Blind Prophet}, climb through the cave, jump off the waterfall and open the chest to receive the {item:Pirate Backpack}, the {item:Pirate Hat} and the {item:Dwarven Ring}.
